plain_text_(steps/results)_still_describ.note: Heuristic scan of title, preconditions, steps and plain expected results (quotes excluded). close_confirmation: the word confirmation within 160 characters after Close (Convert / Reopen / Remove / Make internal / Archive / Delete dialogs excluded) - v1.3 has no Close confirmation in the common case. hints: two hint lines, the QuickBooks mark, Map their expense accounts, first/second hint - v1.3 has one hint line.

_summary.method: A key is listed under a requirement when (a) its codes list carries the id or (b) one of its quoted PRD sentences is a substring of the v1.1 line that changed. Quotes: <li> items under "Exact quotes from the source" (before "References from Design"), HTML stripped and unescaped, whitespace collapsed; PRD markdown backslash escapes and ** removed; checked as substrings of the whole v1.3 body and, as a control, of v1.1. Only PRD quotes are checked (labels starting Tech plan / Jira / Design / PO answer are skipped). Keys that only NAME an id in their text are listed separately under _mentioned_only.
_summary.note_status_row: Every case cites "version 1.1" in its From line, so every case needs its From line re-stamped when rewritten; the Status row is listed only where a case quotes it.
